text:
Samir Patel: Hey team — excited to start! Quick kit issues: monitor arrived but no mounting screws, USB-C dock powers laptop but the built-in webcam and headset mic when plugged into the dock show up as devices but are silent in calls, and corp-secure wifi (802.1X) keeps failing after I authenticate via SSO. Who should I bug?

June - IT: Welcome Samir :wave: Sorry about the rough first hour. Can you confirm OS (Win/mac)? Also can you try plugging the webcam/headset directly to the laptop to rule out the peripherals?

Samir Patel: I'm on Windows 11. Plugged webcam direct and it works fine. When connected to the dock Windows shows "USB Audio Device" and "USB Camera" in Device Manager but Zoom/Teams doesn't list them as available inputs.

June - IT: That usually means the dock enumerates devices but the USB audio/video class isn't routed properly. Quick checks: 1) In Sound Settings set input to the USB device manually, 2) In Camera privacy settings make sure apps are allowed to use camera, 3) Open Device Manager -> Properties on the USB Camera -> Details -> Hardware Ids and paste if you can. I'll open ticket IT-361234 to track.

Samir Patel: Set input manually and toggled camera permissions — still nothing in Teams. Hardware Ids: USB\VID_1BCF&PID_2C99\6&2a3f5b4c&0&3

June - IT: Thanks. That VID/PID looks like the vendor bridge on the dock. Two options: remote driver push for the dock vendor or swap for a known-good dock. I'll schedule a driver push this afternoon under IT-361234. For meanwhile, do you need immediate connectivity for an orientation meeting? I can enable a 45-minute wired token.

Keiko (Logistics): Samir, I flagged a missing M4 x 10 screw kit on the packing manifest and arranged a parts drop. ETA desk delivery: tomorrow morning. If you want same-day, Marco can swing by with a spare.

Marco (Facilities): I have a small hardware pouch — can drop at desk F-3 in ~30min. Want me to bring an allen key too?

Samir Patel: If you can drop it that'd be life-saving, Marco. Desk F-3, yes please bring allen key. Orientation starts in 1 hour, so the wired token would be helpful.

June - IT: Wired token DM sent (45 minutes). Also added note to IT-361234 to prioritize dock swap if driver push fails. For the 802.1X: on Windows try Control Panel -> Credential Manager -> Windows Credentials and remove any saved corp entries, then try joining again. If it still fails, I'll provision a temporary machine profile push.

ops-bot: [IT-361234] Ticket created: "Dock USB AV not routing; missing mounting screws; 802.1X auth failures". Assigned to June - IT. Parts request created.

Samir Patel: Wired token worked, joined call — thanks! Marco the screw kit fits perfectly when you drop by. June I'll paste any Device Manager logs if the driver push happens. Appreciate the rapid help everyone :)
